rule: Show only what's needed now. Reveal details on demand via expand/collapse or drill-down. Don't overwhelm with everything upfront.
when_to_apply: Feature lists with 6+ items. FAQ sections. Detailed product specs. Settings panels.
implementation: Accordion components. 'Show more' links. Tabbed interfaces. Expandable cards. Default to collapsed state.

rule: Every user action needs visible feedback within 100ms. Loading success error and empty states must all be designed.
when_to_apply: Any interactive element: buttons forms submissions searches filters.
implementation: Button: loading spinner + disabled state during async. Toast on success. Inline error on failure. Skeleton screen while loading.

rule: Clickable elements must look clickable. Non-clickable elements must not look clickable. Visual appearance must match function.
when_to_apply: All interactive elements. Links buttons tabs toggles cards-as-links.
implementation: cursor:pointer on clickables. Underline or color on text links. Hover state change. Disabled state visually distinct (opacity 50%).

rule: Prevent errors before they happen rather than recovering after. Validate early. Confirm destructive actions. Disable invalid options.
when_to_apply: Forms with validation. Delete/remove actions. Irreversible operations. Payment flows.
implementation: Inline validation on blur. Disable submit until valid. 'Are you sure?' for deletes. Type-ahead suggestions to prevent typos.

rule: When errors occur: explain what went wrong + suggest how to fix it + preserve user input. Never clear the form on error.
when_to_apply: Form submissions. API failures. 404 pages. Permission errors. Timeout states.
implementation: Error message directly below the field. Keep all entered data. Suggest corrections. Provide 'try again' action.

rule: Every data-driven component must handle 5 states: loading (skeleton) + empty (helpful message) + error (recovery action) + success (data) + permission-denied.
when_to_apply: Any component that fetches or displays dynamic data. Lists tables dashboards profiles.
implementation: Design all 5 states explicitly. Loading: skeleton matching content shape. Empty: illustration + helpful text + CTA. Error: message + retry button.

rule: Let users interact directly with content when possible. Drag to reorder. Click to edit inline. Resize by dragging edges.
when_to_apply: Lists that users reorder. Editable content. Resizable panels. Sortable tables.
implementation: react-beautiful-dnd for drag. contentEditable for inline edit. CSS resize for panels. Click-to-sort table headers.

rule: Prefer undo after action over confirmation before action. 'Email sent. Undo (5s)' is better than 'Are you sure you want to send?'
when_to_apply: Non-destructive actions: sending messages archiving moving items changing settings.
implementation: Toast with undo button + countdown. Delayed execution (5s buffer). Soft-delete with recovery period.

rule: Validate on blur (leaving field) not only on submit. Show errors inline directly below the relevant field. Mark required fields clearly.
when_to_apply: All forms with validation rules. Registration. Checkout. Settings. Profile editing.
implementation: onBlur handler validates field. Error appears below input in red. Required fields marked with asterisk + legend.

rule: Pre-fill with smart defaults. Remember last selections. Reduce typing. Auto-detect what you can (timezone country currency).
when_to_apply: Forms dropdowns date-pickers location-based content language selection.
implementation: Default country from IP. Default date to today. Remember last-used options in localStorage. Auto-format phone numbers.

rule: Primary task achievable in < 3 seconds from page load. One clear CTA per viewport. Don't make users hunt for the main action.
when_to_apply: Landing pages. Product pages. Checkout flows. Sign-up forms.
implementation: Hero CTA visible without scroll. Single primary action per section. Reduce steps to complete core task. Pre-fill where possible.

rule: Place testimonials and trust signals near decision points (pricing CTAs sign-up forms) not in isolated sections far from the action.
when_to_apply: Pricing sections. Sign-up flows. Checkout pages. Any page with a conversion CTA.
implementation: Inline quote near pricing card. Logo bar above CTA section. Star rating next to 'Buy' button. Case study link beside enterprise CTA.
